name: Goosebumps
s: This Canadian children series based on the popular series of books by R.L. Stine adapts some of the best tales in the spinechilling series to the screen.

paragraphs.text: Goosebumps is a children's horror anthology television series based on R. L. Stine's best-selling book series. It is an anthology of stories involving preteens and young teenagers in otherworldly scenarios. The series focuses on the same supernatural and occult themes as the novels, with most episodes directly adapting the original stories.
According to Billboard, some of the VHS releases were among the best-selling children's videos in November 1998.
